desc:
Welcome to NitroLab Drag Racing! The most realistic and competitive drag racing experience on Roblox is here!

Drag race your way through drag classes: Bracket Racing, Index Racing, and Heads-up Racing, where every thousandth of a second counts. Whether you're fine-tuning your setup, buying/selling rare cars, or battling friends at the strip, NitroLab is built for drag racing fans who love speed.

NEW CODES AT 70K LIKES!!!

⚠️ Alpha Notice: Early version of the game, you may encounter bugs, incomplete features & performance issues.

🚗 Build, tune and customize your dream race cars
🏁 Drag race friends or go for personal bests on official NLDR tracks
🏆 Set records and earn exclusive trophies + badges
🥇 VIP Game pass will give you a 20% cash boost!
💎 Premium members will get loads of benefits + a tag in-game!

👥 Join our group & server for updates + organized racing tournaments!

🔔 Don't forget to FOLLOW + FAVORITE!
